0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 1-5 at home, on a nine-game losing streak) host the Orlando Magic (3-7, 0-4 at home, riding a one-game win streak) in the Jazz's 12th game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), and Keyonte George (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), with Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain) also day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Jazz lost 0-2 to Orlando in 2025-26, including a 120-117 loss in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
